steps.description: Targeted validation run required for correction plan

validation_request.policy_content:
Gentle AI native bounded review policy.

Only candidate-caused BLOCKER or CRITICAL findings may require correction. Pre-existing and base-only findings are follow-ups. One correction is bounded by the frozen original scope. Gates are informational and unmanaged; ordinary repository policy decides delivery.

fix_findings.claim: An explicit REQUIREMENTS_PYTHON selection is silently discarded when it is unavailable or supplied as an interpreter name resolved through PATH. The launcher substitutes python3, so probe can report success under a different interpreter and analyze can use a different solver installation. Preserve fallback only for the implicit default; resolve or reject an explicit selection instead.
proof_refs: bin/gentle-ai:10-11 selects the explicit environment value and then unconditionally replaces any value failing the executable-path test with python3.
skills/requerimientos-socraticos/references/formal-analysis.md:116-117 documents REQUIREMENTS_PYTHON as selecting the installed interpreter.

skills/requerimientos-socraticos/tests/test_environment.py:14-17 and skills/requerimientos-socraticos/tests/test_logic.py:16-21 invoke scripts directly, leaving launcher interpreter selection untested.

fix_findings.claim: An explicitly selected REQUIREMENTS_PYTHON interpreter is silently discarded when it is missing or not executable. For example, after a configured virtual environment is removed during an upgrade, probe still succeeds using python3, and analyze can succeed using a different installed solver environment. This hides the broken runtime configuration and violates the documented interpreter selection. Fall back only when no explicit override was supplied; otherwise report the unavailable interpreter and exit nonzero.

fix_classifications.proof:
bin/gentle-ai:10-11 selects the explicit environment value and then unconditionally replaces any value failing the executable-path test with python3.

skills/requerimientos-socraticos/tests/test_environment.py:14-17 and skills/requerimientos-socraticos/tests/test_logic.py:16-21 invoke scripts directly, leaving launcher interpreter selection untested.
